seeds.scene: Two near-identical portrait photos of identical twins side by side; differences only in eyebrow asymmetry, freckle count under the right eye, and earlobe attachment.
seeds.question: How many distinct facial differences are visible between the twins?
seeds.lever: Identify subtle pairwise face differences and count only the distinct categories, not occurrences.

seeds.scene: Six keys in a row above six lock cylinders; each key shows its bitting profile, each cylinder shows its pin-pattern silhouette. Only one key's bitting matches each cylinder; some keys are decoys and match nothing.
seeds.question: How many of the six keys actually match a lock on the bench?
seeds.lever: Match key bitting heights to cylinder pin gaps; count valid matches, not just visually similar pairs.

seeds.scene: Four watch dials side-by-side, each showing the seconds hand at a different position. A note: 'all four watches were set to the same time and started simultaneously 3 minutes ago — find the one that has stopped or is running fast.'
seeds.question: Which dial shows the FAULTY watch?
seeds.answer: the dial whose seconds-hand position is inconsistent with the others by more than allowed drift
seeds.lever: Compare relative seconds-hand offset; identify the outlier vs the cluster.

seeds.scene: Top row shows 5 dirt shoeprints; bottom row shows 5 shoe soles in a different order. Each sole has a unique tread pattern (chevron, herringbone, lugged, smooth, hex grid).
seeds.question: Which print pairs with the herringbone sole?
seeds.answer: the print whose tread image shows the herringbone pattern
seeds.lever: Match tread geometry between print impression and shoe sole, ignoring scale and orientation.

seeds.scene: Top row: 6 cast shadows projected on a wall (rabbit, bird, dog, fish, hand, scissors). Bottom row: 6 candidate hand-puppet shapes in a different order.
seeds.question: Which puppet casts the bird shadow?
seeds.answer: the puppet whose silhouette geometry matches the bird shadow
seeds.lever: Mentally project 3D hand shape onto 2D silhouette and match across rotation.

seeds.scene: Six screws of similar diameter and four nuts of similar bore. Each screw and nut shows visible thread pitch (turns per cm). Pitches differ across the screws and nuts.
seeds.question: How many screws have a matching nut on the tray?
seeds.answer: varies by setup; compute by matching pitch within tolerance
seeds.lever: Pair fasteners by thread pitch (and diameter), counting only tight matches.

seeds.scene: A 3x3 grid of 9 nearly-identical product shots; eight are the same photo, one differs subtly (small price-tag color change, missing UPC bar, or off-by-one count).
seeds.question: Which cell contains the OUTLIER, and what is the difference?
seeds.answer: specify cell and the single difference
seeds.lever: Cross-compare all cells and pinpoint the unique low-salience deviation.

seeds.scene: An assembled jigsaw puzzle with one missing slot; below it sit 6 candidate pieces with similar tab/blank patterns and partial imagery.
seeds.question: Which candidate piece fits the missing slot?
seeds.answer: the piece whose tabs, blanks, and image continuation match
seeds.lever: Match both interlock geometry AND image continuity; reject pieces with one but not both.

seeds.scene: Top: 4 x-ray images of luggage interiors. Bottom: 4 outline silhouette diagrams of those luggages' exterior with object placements roughly indicated. Match each x-ray to its outline.
seeds.question: Which outline corresponds to x-ray #2?
seeds.answer: the outline whose object positions and shapes align with x-ray #2
seeds.lever: Cross-modality matching: equate dense radiographic shapes with sparse outlined positions.

seeds.scene: Top row: a sofa fabric photographed under cool LED lighting. Bottom row: 4 candidate fabric swatches photographed under warm tungsten lighting. The same physical fabric appears different under the two lights.
seeds.question: Which candidate IS the same physical fabric as the sofa?
seeds.answer: the swatch whose under-tungsten color is the warm-light-shifted version of the sofa color
seeds.lever: Apply color-temperature correction mentally to compare across lighting conditions.

seeds.scene: Top: 3 reference handwriting samples by writers W1, W2, W3 (each writing a paragraph). Bottom: 1 unknown short note. Letter-formation cues: slant, loop closure on 'g', 'a' style (round vs Greek), pen lift in 't'.
seeds.question: Which writer most likely wrote the unknown note?
seeds.answer: the writer whose letterform features match across all three cues
seeds.lever: Multi-cue handwriting feature matching across slant, letter shape, pen mechanics.

seeds.scene: A reference chart of 10 pills (color, shape, imprint) and a tray of 4 unknown loose pills photographed beside it. Some unknowns match exactly; some have wrong imprint despite identical color/shape.
seeds.question: How many unknowns appear on the reference chart?
seeds.lever: Require simultaneous match on color + shape + imprint; lookalikes with wrong imprint do not count.

seeds.scene: An open botany guide page lists 6 tree species with leaf silhouettes; beside the book lie 4 freshly-collected leaves photographed against a white sheet.
seeds.question: Which collected leaf belongs to species 'Acer rubrum' as shown in the guide?
seeds.answer: the leaf whose lobing and venation match Acer rubrum
seeds.lever: Match leaf morphological features (lobe count, margin teeth, venation pattern) to taxonomic key.

seeds.scene: Top: 3 named speakers' reference voiceprints (waveform spectrograms). Bottom: 1 unknown clip's spectrogram. Differences in formant placement, pitch contour, and vibrato visible.
seeds.question: Which speaker most likely produced the unknown clip?
seeds.answer: the reference whose formant pattern best matches
seeds.lever: Spectrogram pattern matching; reject high-pitch/low-pitch confusables based on formant location, not just intensity.

seeds.scene: Eight pottery shards on a table; 4 form one vessel, 4 form another. Each shard shows its curvature, glaze color, and edge pattern. Two vessels have similar but distinguishable glazes.
seeds.question: How many shards belong to vessel A (the cream-glazed one)?
seeds.lever: Group shards by glaze color and curvature, match edge patterns within group; reject crossover lookalikes.

seeds.scene: Top: a poster set in two unidentified fonts. Bottom: 6 candidate font specimens labeled with names. Subtle differences: terminal shape on 'a', stroke contrast, x-height ratio.
seeds.question: Which two named fonts were used on the poster?
seeds.answer: names of the matching fonts based on letterform features
seeds.lever: Identify fonts by detail features (terminals, contrast, joins) ignoring superficial size differences.

seeds.scene: Six eggs on a scale display, each with a measured weight tag. A reference card on the wall maps weight ranges to grades: Peewee, Small, Medium, Large, X-Large, Jumbo.
seeds.question: How many eggs grade as LARGE per the chart?
seeds.answer: count from cross-referencing weight to grade ranges
seeds.lever: Read each weight, look up the grade row, count only Large; resist neighboring-grade lookalikes.

seeds.scene: Two chest x-rays of the same patient labeled 'before' and 'after treatment'. Differences localized to a small lung region: opacity reduced, slight rib position difference due to inspiration depth.
seeds.question: Which change is REAL pathology change vs. artifact of breathing depth?
seeds.answer: the opacity change (real) vs rib position (artifact)
seeds.lever: Distinguish disease-related change from imaging-physics artifact; require constancy under repositioning.

seeds.scene: Five glasses of red wine in a row, each tilted at a 45° angle showing a thin meniscus rim color. Younger wines show purple rim, older wines show brick-orange rim. A printed key maps rim color to age range.
seeds.question: Which glass holds the OLDEST wine?
seeds.answer: the glass with the most orange/brick rim
seeds.lever: Read meniscus rim hue, not core color; brick = oldest, deep purple = youngest.

seeds.scene: Top: 4 tire sidewall shots showing size codes (e.g., 205/55R16). Bottom: 4 vehicle profile shots with their required size posted in the door jamb (visible insets).
seeds.question: Which tire fits vehicle #3?
seeds.answer: the tire whose code matches vehicle #3's spec
seeds.lever: Parse tire size code from sidewall and match to vehicle spec; reject one-letter/one-number-off lookalikes.
